items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: I knew him quite well in Chicago.

ctx.x: Oh shit. Jimmy Noon. Oh shit. When did Jimmy Noon take up clarinet? He was a whole lot younger than you, wasn't he? Yes. He's dead now, but he's... Oh yeah. I knew him quite well in Chicago. Yeah you knew him. Yeah. He lived for me.
Did any of the white musicians study with you too? Eh? Any of the white musicians study with you?
